title: DeFT: Decoding with Flash Tree-attention for Efficient Tree-structured LLM Inference

layout.note: One tall single-column figure: a top row of two boxes side by side (dashed grey Sequence-based decoding at the left, framed Notations key at the right), under it one large cream box titled Tree-based decoding holding four numbered mini trees stacked in a column; the first two are drawn side by side in one band, the last two take a band each. Underlined numbered captions sit below each mini tree.

lesson: Define the node colours once in a Notations box (shareable versus non-shareable), then redraw the same node grammar for each application so the shared blue parts stand out across different tree shapes; put the sequential baseline above as unconnected pairs.
